root_path_disclosure: The exact host path was supplied by the operator. Artifacts use <I0_ROOT> to avoid publishing the Windows username.

capture_range.timestamp_rule: Use embedded session or event UTC only for range membership. Filesystem creation and write times are inventory metadata and never scientific selection fields.
capture_range.missing_embedded_utc_rule: Retain the structural candidate in inventory and quarantine it unless an enclosing hash-bound session manifest supplies the capture interval.

directory_exclusion_rules: Exclude .git, .github, __pycache__, .pytest_cache, .mypy_cache, node_modules, .venv, venv and virtual-environment trees.
Exclude backup, backups, _backups, repair_backups, temp, tmp and cache trees from candidate evidence; record their existence only as excluded metadata when encountered.
Exclude source, scripts, tests, docs and package-build trees unless a file is referenced by a candidate session manifest as immutable evidence.
Do not extract ZIP, TAR, 7Z or other archives during this stage.
Do not follow junctions, symlinks, reparse points or paths resolving outside a declared root.
Exclude the A18.44 origin, methods-freeze and replay-corpus-freeze directories from the historical candidate frame.

candidate_session_detection_rule.minimum: A directory or manifest must declare a stable session_id or run_id and contain at least one structural evidence marker.
structural_evidence_markers: wave_epoch ledger or equivalent declared A18.42 evidence

forbidden_selection_fields: apparent support for The Mercy Limit

enumeration_contract.reason_not_started: METHODS_SPLIT_UNDERSPECIFIED detected before candidate outcome-field access; the authorization requires immediate stop rather than inventing a partition rule.

methods_split_precheck.finding: The frozen methods define partition separation and sample sizes but no deterministic mapping from a historical candidate session to CALIBRATION or EVALUATION.
